## Detailed Description
The regular and attached [activated()](qml-memberlinkqml-signalorigins.md#activated-signal) signals each register the same signal-detail target, immediately followed by their own section heading. Links to signal-detail that are authored in a signal body or see-also list must resolve to the authoring signal's own section.
